templates.why_chosen: Doc-cited exemplar of the two-small-hubs variant: GKBuilder and GKProbe sit as paired hubs inside the VMM band, mediating a Target/Observer pair above the Hypervisor's EPT pill band, plus a lettered key and numbered path.
templates.what_to_learn: Colour-code new components differently from the existing infrastructure they sit inside (white boxes on a grey VMM here) and give the bottom hardware band its own row of small pills; the weakness is that overlaying a lettered key and a numbered step sequence on one figure slows parsing, so pick one scheme per diagram.
